data_gaps: Exact Google review counts were not visible for His & Her Preference, Kris Lash, Nails Be On, Unique Nails, Davi Nails, Yoyo Nails & Spa and Nails Touch.
No staff counts, owners or years in business were found for any of the ten; none publish team or licence details.
Jenny Skin Care's advertised domain (jenny-skincare.com) failed DNS, so no site content could be reviewed.
Yelp pages were not opened, so complaint patterns about waits, missed calls or phone handling could not be verified for any salon.
Davi Nails' East Brunswick unit details (local hours, staff, pricing) are franchise-controlled and were not individually reviewable.

Whether the Fresha profiles for Unique Nails, Nails Touch and Yoyo Nails & Spa can take real online bookings could not be confirmed: the pages showed service categories but no bookable calendar or prices.
